_comment: M2 Anomaly/Event Detector policy for the FloodGuard MVP. Edit this file to retune the rule-based detection thresholds -- no code changes required, just restart the server (same reload rule as config/zonePolicy.json and config/alertPolicy.json). This is a rule-based stand-in for real video-based event classification (see services/m2Detect.js) -- an event is flagged when EITHER rise_rate_m_per_hr or rainfall_1h (mm) from the location's latest mock readings exceeds its threshold. saturation_headroom controls how far past the threshold (as a fraction of the threshold) a value must be before anomaly_score/confidence saturate at 1.0 -- e.g. 1.0 means they max out once the value is double the threshold. These are prototype placeholder numbers, not validated operational thresholds.
